reviewer: AI visual interpretation; owner road review pending

method: Approximate visible pavement edges manually interpreted on 25 m transects of the pinned CartoCiudad 300 m clip. Tangent uses +/-2 m station window; signed offset follows EPSG left normal (-dy,dx). Linear interpolation between observations is inference, not a boundary survey. Shadows, curbs and imagery date are unresolved.
uncertainty_is: review allowance, not measured statistical accuracy

review_history.trigger: Contact trial rejected; middle-width fit inspection found extreme departures near stations 125-128 and 175-177 m.
review_history.review: Magnified pinned-photo transects show initial estimates at 125 and 175 extended beyond pavement into roadside ground; reinterpreted edges. This is source interpretation correction, not automated narrowing to meet contact thresholds.
review_history.remaining_limits: 13 transects and interpolation remain coarse, especially near the hairpin; imagery age, shadows and edge accuracy are unresolved. No width/earthwork/physics admission.
